'''Crevasse City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. 

It was seen as the epitome of Alderaanian culture, noted for its spectacular beauty, as it balanced between nature and urbanization in a beautiful blend. As such, it was considered one of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Characteristics==
Crevasse City was located in a canyon. It had no [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], but public transportation linked the city with [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]], which handled all the city's space traffic. The city boasted creature comforts of all kinds, including restaurants, bars and parks, and by reputation had the best [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] on the planet. It held the seat of the [[House of Metara]] noble family.

The lowest levels of the crevasse remained untouched throughout Alderaan's history and featured a maze of caverns containing beautiful [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] formations, hot springs and underground lakes.

The surface of Crevasse City received no more than six [[Time/Legends|hours]] of sunlight a day, and the city streets and hallways were filled with artificial lighting built into the architecture in various artistic and clever forms. The [[Color/Legends|colors]] of the lights took on unique meanings: white for death and mourning, blue for happiness, green for love, silver for prosperity, and orange for danger or warning.

Hidden in a far corner of the city lay its industrial section. Crevasse City was powered by geothermal power plants. It was also the home of one of Alderaan's only [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations and the [[Crevasse City Collegium for Young Ladies]].

==History==
The city was constructed downwards, meaning the oldest buildings were on the surface, with newer facilities being built lower into the crevasse. The lowest levels remained untouched.

Already in [[10,000 BBY]] it was considered a spectacle; that year, the historian [[Vicendi]] in his publication ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]'' decided to include it in his list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

Like the rest of Alderaan, it was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />
